title: Number of Segments in a String
description: Given a string `s`, return the number of segments in the string. A segment is defined as a maximal contiguous sequence of non-space characters.
constraints: s consists of printable ASCII characters including spaces.
hints: A new segment starts at index i whenever s[i] is not a space and either i == 0 or s[i - 1] is a space.
Be careful with empty strings, strings containing only spaces, and multiple consecutive spaces.

examples.explanation: A string with only spaces has 0 segments.
